title: ML Studio 2026.11.20.1
notes:
- Added ML Drums, an eight-pad drum machine with a built-in kit, sequencer, sample drag-and-drop, effects, and MIDI export.
- Added Pitch Draw in the Piano Roll with editable bends and vibrato. Supported instruments can play independent note bends. Conventional plugins with a pitch wheel can follow a shared bend.
- Fixed the disabled Download 32-bit VST2 bridge button on Windows. Installing the bridge automatically rescans for legacy plugins.
- Fixed a Windows crash when dropping samples onto ML Drums pads. Undo restores the previous pad sample.
- Added Auto gain to headphone correction to keep monitoring levels more consistent when switching profiles.
- The Playlist Video track can set up FFmpeg on first use and reuse an existing installation, including the Visualizer’s FFmpeg on Windows.
- Windows ASIO buffer changes made in a driver’s control panel now survive the driver restart.
- Playlist loop selections now survive saving and reopening. New instrument takes can use free lanes below the active take.
- Improved recording count-in feedback, Channel Strip fader response, and pattern numbering and playback indicators in the Channel Rack.
- Updated Mac download links and first-launch instructions. Both Mac packages now check the app and bundled components against the macOS 12 minimum.

https://michaellanemusic.de/ml-studio/
